precondition: Validate Purchase (username/email/order ID) is required before many unrelated procedures continue, but the *validation mechanic itself* carries no branching logic -- it is a gate, not a rule with a consequence that differs by input, so it was not encoded as a standalone testable rule anywhere on its own. (subcluster: purchase_dispute)
postcondition: No policy-governed consequence follows from this step alone; observed across 6 distinct subflows (bad_price_competitor, bad_price_yesterday, mistimed_billing_already_returned, mistimed_billing_never_bought, out_of_stock_general, out_of_stock_one_item).
negative_control_name: Purchase validation as a bare prerequisite (purchase_dispute)
